Vehicles only. Plates stay masked until a duty officer is named. · The assistant proposes. A named officer decides every action.
dashed: modelled, simulated, emulated or unverified (or shown only when needed)
Featured decision: the soonest of the decisions waiting, with its place on a map, two or three figures and
one primary button. Orange marks what waits for a named officer.
City pulse: the band, four counts and the data line that says what is live, modelled, emulated or simulated.
What needs you: proposals from decision support (waterlogging nowcast, signal-timing twin, corridor
forecast). None acts on its own; if no one decides, the current plan holds.
What is happening: live operations (here a simulated Durga Puja crowd event and the modelled nowcast) and
reports about places from the city, each with its label.
What is coming: forecast crossings (on simulated traffic until Kolkata traffic is recorded), the modelled
